verdict.rationale: Remote's own CLI exports every list command to CSV and can emit JSON for any command, and the API lets you pull workforce and payroll data out, so open-format export exists. Nothing documents a complete, all-data account export or an offboarding path for leaving the platform. Missing for 10: documented full-account/bulk data export covering all data types, an account closure/offboarding and portability process, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Every list command exports to CSV with `-o csv`, and every command can emit JSON, so the output drops straight into spreadsheets and scripts.
export any list straight to a spreadsheet.
pull workforce and payroll data out to your systems
